media.title: Akira O'Connor on Déjà vu
media.channel: Quiz a Whiz with the RSE

timecodes.what: Akira O'Connor (University of St Andrews) defines déjà vu as the conflict between subjective familiarity and objective knowledge that a moment is new.
Akira O'Connor explains how missing-theme word lists triggered déjà vu inside the St Andrews fMRI scanner and illuminated frontal fact-checking regions.
